rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Piramal Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of meeting of Committee of Directors (Administration, Authorization and Finance) held today i.e. Friday, 4th September 2026'.

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Piramal Finance Limited (Formerly known as Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Limited) has informed the Exchange regarding intimation of meeting of Committee of Directors (Administration, Authorization and Finance) to be held on Friday, 4th September 2026 inter alia, to consider and approve a proposal for partial redemption at the option of the debenture holders of secured, rated, listed, redeemable non-convertible debentures issued by the Company in accordance with the terms of the private placement memorandum

rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Piramal Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 31, 2026, titled "Piramal Finance announces Rs. 3,850 crore Capital Raise, Backed by Strong QIP Participation and Promoter Warrants.".
